title: Food and Nutrition Act of 2008
verified_how: Fetched govinfo USCODE-2024 7 U.S.C. 2011. The Short Title note says the Act, which enacted the chapter, 'may be cited as the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008' (formerly the Food Stamp Act of 1977).
notes: The statute for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP).
